bianchi-identity-field-strength-7abb95d9.title: The Bianchi Identity (Homogeneous Maxwell)
bianchi-identity-field-strength-7abb95d9.interpretation: Asserts the topological closedness of the electromagnetic field strength, proving the absence of magnetic monopoles in the standard vacuum.
bianchi-identity-field-strength-7abb95d9.symmetry_origin: The geometric requirement that the exterior derivative of a gradient vanish identically ($d^2 = 0$).
bianchi-identity-field-strength-7abb95d9.limits_and_boundary: Unifies Faraday's Law and Gauss's Law for Magnetism into a single geometric constraint.

meissner-flux-expulsion-ident-3440877a.title: Magnetic Flux Expulsion (Meissner)
meissner-flux-expulsion-ident-3440877a.interpretation: Describes the active cancellation of internal magnetic induction in a superconductor, distinguishing it from a simple perfect conductor.
meissner-flux-expulsion-ident-3440877a.symmetry_origin: The rigidity of the macroscopic quantum phase and the requirement of energy minimization in a magnetic field.
meissner-flux-expulsion-ident-3440877a.limits_and_boundary: Only holds below the critical magnetic field Hc; above this, the material either reverts to the normal state (Type I) or enters the vortex state (Type II).

inner-product-norm-ident-6472517f.title: Hilbert Space Inner Product
inner-product-norm-ident-6472517f.interpretation: Defines the norm of a state vector in Hilbert space through the positive-definite inner product, ensuring that the probability density of any quantum state is always non-negative.
inner-product-norm-ident-6472517f.symmetry_origin: The requirement of a metric structure on the complex vector space to support the probabilistic interpretation of quantum mechanics.
inner-product-norm-ident-6472517f.limits_and_boundary: Only vanishes if the state vector is the zero vector, providing the unassailable variational foundation for the normalization of the wave function.

isomorphism-physical-mathematical-map-c3.title: Physical-Mathematical Isomorphism
isomorphism-physical-mathematical-map-c3.interpretation: Describes the 1-to-1 mapping between physical properties P and mathematical relationships M, which characterizes the realist position that equations reveal the true nature of the vacuum.
isomorphism-physical-mathematical-map-c3.symmetry_origin: The structural coherence between the formalisms of theoretical physics and empirical observations.
isomorphism-physical-mathematical-map-c3.limits_and_boundary: Serves as the objective foundation for the use of group theory and differential geometry in classifying particles and forces.
